Microsoft.title: Microsoft AI's CMO is leaving as the company rethinks consumer marketing efforts
Microsoft.titleEn: Microsoft AI's CMO is leaving as the company rethinks consumer marketing efforts
Microsoft.titleKo: Microsoft AI의 CMO는 회사가 소비자 마케팅 활동을 재고함에 따라 떠남
Microsoft.summary:
Work on both these projects began before Mallard joined the company.
Microsoft AI's chief marketing officer, Andréa Mallard, started transitioning out of her post about six months after being appointed to the role, Business Insider has learned.
Two people familiar with the matter said Mallard's departure also reflected a recent change in strategy at Microsoft AI as the company rethinks consumer marketing.

The sidebar becomes the chat's own navigation while you are in a conversation: New chat, Agents, Cockpit, and a More group with History, Projects, Teams, Group Chat, Organization, and Add-Ons and Skills.
Start instantly with Skales IQ, a free built-in trial that needs no API key, bring your own from 15+ AI providers, or run fully offline with Ollama.

Microsoft.titleKo: GitHub - yashab-cyber/opendroid: 개방형 자율 Android 에이전트 — 로컬/원격 LLM 및 접근성 기반 화면 자동화를 기반으로 하는 프로덕션 준비, 자체 계획 AI 도우미임
Microsoft.summary:
The project compiles against Java 21 ( jvmToolchain(21) ). gradle/gradle-daemon-jvm.properties makes ./gradlew select an installed JDK 21 automatically, so you do not have to change JAVA_HOME — but a JDK 21 must be installed.
Clean architecture with Dagger-Hilt dependency injection: OpenDroid supports 12 LLM providers with automatic failover: Smart Fallback : If your primary provider fails, OpenDroid automatically tries the next available provider in the chain.
It's a fully autonomous AI agent that lives on your Android phone and actually does things for you.

NVIDIA.titleEn: China lets Nvidia's H200 chips trickle onto the mainland to help its AI firms keep pace with the US

NVIDIA.summary:
Chinese labs are catching up on the technical side.
China is letting small batches of Nvidia's H200 chips onto the mainland to help domestic AI firms in the race with the US.
The H200 is at least two generations behind Nvidia's most powerful chips, which China can't buy because of US export controls.

NVIDIA.title: Securing the Infrastructure of Intelligence
NVIDIA.summary:
Each generation of NVIDIA AI factory systems deployed at PORTS-Pike could represent approximately 1.5 million NVIDIA GPUs, or approximately $150 billion to $200 billion in NVIDIA revenue.
They build and operate AI factories using NVIDIA accelerated computing, networking, systems and software.
They may have strong customer demand and rapidly growing revenue yet still lack the decades-long infrastructure contracts and investment-grade financing capacity needed to secure the AI factory infrastructure independently.

summaryLinesKo: PORTS-Pike에 배포된 각 세대의 NVIDIA AI 공장 시스템은 약 150만 개의 NVIDIA GPU, 즉 NVIDIA 수익에서 약 1,500억~2,000억 달러를 나타낼 수 있음
그들은 NVIDIA 가속 컴퓨팅, 네트워킹, 시스템 및 소프트웨어를 사용하여 AI 공장을 구축하고 운영함
그들은 강력한 고객 수요와 빠르게 성장하는 수익을 보유하고 있지만 AI 공장 인프라를 독립적으로 확보하는 데 필요한 수십 년 간의 인프라 계약과 투자 등급 자금 조달 능력이 여전히 부족할 수 있음

NVIDIA.title: Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat and NVIDIA Open Indonesia’s First University AI Center to Develop Local AI Talent
NVIDIA.titleEn: Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat and NVIDIA Open Indonesia’s First University AI Center to Develop Local AI Talent
NVIDIA.titleKo: Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat, NVIDIA가 현지 AI 인재 개발을 위해 인도네시아 최초의 대학 AI 센터 개설
NVIDIA.summary:
“Through initiatives like this, we are laying the foundations of Indonesia’s AI sovereignty and ensuring AI becomes a driver of economic growth, national competitiveness and solutions to Indonesia’s most pressing challenges.”
This week, the Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi), Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison (Indosat or IOH), NVIDIA and Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) launched the UGM Indosat NVIDIA AI Technology Center (NVAITC) in Yogyakarta — the country’s first university-based AI technology center.
“This initiative supports national priorities in higher education, research downstreaming and talent development by accelerating the adoption of AI and preparing future-ready Indonesian talent.”

“This initiative supports national priorities in higher education, research downstreaming and talent development by accelerating the adoption of AI and preparing future-ready Indonesian talent.”

이번 주 통신디지털부(Komdigi), Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison(Indosat 또는 IOH), NVIDIA 및 Universitas Gadjah Mada(UGM)는 족자카르타에 국내 최초의 대학 기반 AI 기술 센터인 UGM Indosat NVIDIA AI 기술 센터(NVAITC)를 설립함

NVIDIA.title: Nvidia's new $500B plan is risky but brilliant, especially for aging GPUs
NVIDIA.titleEn: Nvidia's new $500B plan is risky but brilliant, especially for aging GPUs
NVIDIA.titleKo: Nvidia의 새로운 5000억 달러 계획은 위험하지만 훌륭함 · 특히 노후화된 GPU의 경우 더욱 그렇음
NVIDIA.summary:
Nvidia announced this week that Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR were willing to commit up to $500 billion to build AI data centers.
The risk is that today’s AI boom, where demand far outstrips capacity, doesn’t continue for much longer.
Specifically, Nvidia is promising that if GPUs used as collateral don’t retain their value as expected, the company will cover up to 25% of the difference.

NVIDIA.titleEn: SPONSORED: Sovereign AI overcomes compliance challenges and feeds innovation in public sector and other regulated industries, say HPE and NVIDIA
NVIDIA.titleKo: 후원 · HPE와 NVIDIA에 따르면 Sovereign AI는 규정 준수 문제를 극복하고 공공 부문 및 기타 규제 산업에 혁신을 제공함
NVIDIA.summary:
Pienaar and Shirhatti sit on the frontline of this shift in AI development.
The HPE Sovereign AI Factory lets customers in highly-regulated industries keep sensitive data, models, and operations under strict local control, using customized, validated infrastructure integrated with HPE services from deployment to operational support that helps customers with security, compliance, and control across infrastructure, data, and AI models.
But new mandates governing AI deployments also require them to act as careful custodians of their data, along with the infrastructure, supply chain, software and other aspects of their IT landscape.

NVIDIA.title: NVIDIA AI Factory Compute Is Becoming an Investable Asset Class
NVIDIA.titleEn: NVIDIA AI Factory Compute Is Becoming an Investable Asset Class
NVIDIA.titleKo: NVIDIA AI 팩토리 컴퓨팅은 투자 가능한 자산 클래스가 되고 있음
NVIDIA.summary:
Blackwell capacity commands a premium, with reported B200 cloud rates spanning approximately $5.30 to $7.05 per GPU-hour.
We have moved from an era in which companies bought chips and built data centers project by project to one in which AI factories can be financed as productive infrastructure — with repeatable platforms, long-term institutional capital and a diverse customer base that uses compute to create revenue.
We announced partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to establish independent financing platforms designed to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital to support the buildout of AI infrastructure over time.
summaryLinesEn: Blackwell capacity commands a premium, with reported B200 cloud rates spanning approximately $5.30 to $7.05 per GPU-hour.

We announced partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to establish independent financing platforms designed to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital to support the buildout of AI infrastructure over time.
summaryLinesKo: Blackwell 용량은 GPU 시간당 약 5.30~7.05달러에 달하는 보고된 B200 클라우드 요금으로 프리미엄을 요구함
우리는 기업이 칩을 구입하고 프로젝트별로 데이터 센터를 구축하던 시대에서 반복 가능한 플랫폼, 장기 기관 자본 및 컴퓨팅을 사용하여 수익을 창출하는 다양한 고객 기반을 갖춘 생산적인 인프라로 AI 공장에 자금을 조달할 수 있는 시대로 전환함
우리는 Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs 및 KKR과의 파트너십을 발표하여 시간이 지남에 따라 AI 인프라 구축을 지원하기 위해 5,000억 달러 이상의 제3자 자본을 동원하도록 설계된 독립적인 금융 플랫폼을 구축함

NVIDIA.title: NVIDIA CEO Tops Glassdoor’s 2026 List of Best CEOs
NVIDIA.titleEn: NVIDIA CEO Tops Glassdoor’s 2026 List of Best CEOs
NVIDIA.titleKo: NVIDIA CEO, Glassdoor의 2026년 최고의 CEO 목록에서 1위를 차지
NVIDIA.summary:
This award recognizes CEOs “who are leading with empathy, clarity and purpose” at a time when workers are navigating increased uncertainty in the job market, according to Glassdoor, which analyzes employee ratings and reviews to identify the leaders who have earned the highest levels of employee approval and trust.
“As AI and shifting expectations redefine the modern workplace, exceptional leadership has never been more vital,” Glassdoor noted.
Glassdoor reintroduced the Best CEOs list this year after a hiatus of five years, replacing the Best-Led Companies list, which ranked NVIDIA at No. 1 in 2025, in a shift to sharpen the focus on CEO and executive leadership and its impact on employee experience and company reputation.

Glassdoor는 “AI와 변화하는 기대치가 현대 직장을 재정의함에 따라 뛰어난 리더십이 그 어느 때보다 중요해졌음” · 라고 말함

Apple.title: Rothschild upgrades Apple to Buy as foldable iPhone and AI strategy drive optimism
Apple.titleEn: Rothschild upgrades Apple to Buy as foldable iPhone and AI strategy drive optimism
Apple.titleKo: Rothschild는 폴더블 iPhone 및 AI 전략이 낙관론을 주도함에 따라 Apple을 구매로 업그레이드함
Apple.summary:
Rothschild & Co Redburn has upgraded Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) from Neutral to Buy and lifted its price target sharply to $400 from $260, citing the company's expected entry into foldable smartphones alongside the potential evolution of its artificial intelligence strategy.
A shift towards open-source models could nevertheless give Apple greater flexibility as it attempts to strengthen its position in generative AI without bearing all the costs and development risks associated with building frontier models internally.
Apple's continued dependence on third-party AI models also remains a strategic risk if the company is unable to establish a more independent approach to artificial intelligence.

Apple.title: Apple trained its own AI model for China with help from Alibaba
Apple.titleEn: Apple trained its own AI model for China with help from Alibaba
Apple.titleKo: Apple은 Alibaba의 도움을 받아 중국을 위한 자체 AI 모델을 훈련시켰음
Apple.summary:
The China-focused model gives Apple a leg up as a US company navigating Beijing’s difficult regulatory landscape, particularly given escalating tensions surrounding AI development in recent months.
The China-focused large language model was developed in partnership with Alibaba and trained with the company’s support, Reuters reports , citing three unnamed people familiar with the matter.
The report comes as Apple gears up to release Apple Intelligence in China.

Apple.summary:
In Engadget's early testing of Siri AI , the digital assistant was a major improvement over the version most consumers have access to right now, but it was hard not to feel like Apple still has a lot of catching up to do.

Eligible students in the US can score one year of Google AI Pro for free, which includes 5TB of storage, Google Health Premium , higher usage limits on Gemini, and access to Gemini across Google apps.

Google DeepMind.title: Android users just got one of Chrome's biggest Gemini upgrades
Google DeepMind.titleEn: Android users just got one of Chrome's biggest Gemini upgrades
Google DeepMind.titleKo: Android 사용자는 Chrome의 가장 큰 Gemini 업그레이드 중 하나를 받았음
Google DeepMind.summary:
On your phone, it essentially gives Chrome its own built-in AI assistant that can understand the page you’re looking at and help you do more with it.
Gemini in Chrome is now available to Android users across the US, bringing page summaries, contextual questions, Google app connections, and Nano Banana image tools directly into the browser.
Instead of manually opening hotel listings, comparing prices, checking availability, and moving through several booking pages, you could ask Gemini to help handle much of that process.

이제 미국 전역의 Android 사용자가 Chrome의 Gemini를 사용할 수 있으며 페이지 요약, 상황별 질문, Google 앱 연결 및 Nano Banana 이미지 도구를 브라우저에 직접 제공함

Previously, Alexa+ cost $19.99 per month for anyone who didn’t have an Amazon Prime membership, and was initially made available to the new Fire TV devices the company announced last fall.

Amazon.title: Amazon, which started off selling books, is destroying rare texts to train AI
Amazon.titleEn: Amazon, which started off selling books, is destroying rare texts to train AI
Amazon.titleKo: 책 판매로 시작한 아마존, AI 훈련 위해 희귀 텍스트 파괴
Amazon.summary:
Companies like Amazon need unfathomably large amounts of text to train their LLMs, which have already ingested what they can from the internet (and, in Anthropic’s case, illegally pirated books).
Amazon is buying tons of rare books, cutting off their spines, and scanning them for AI training, according to 404 Media , which placed a tracking device in a rare book that ultimately arrived at an Amazon facility in Las Vegas.
When LLMs train on AI-generated text, they risk “ model collapse ,” which can occur when the quality of an LLM’s outputs degrade after ingesting too much AI-generated text.

404 Media에 따르면 Amazon은 수많은 희귀 도서를 구입하여 등뼈를 잘라 AI 훈련을 위해 스캔하고 있다고 함 · 404 Media는 최종적으로 라스베거스의 Amazon 시설에 도착한 희귀 도서에 추적 장치를 배치함

Amazon.summary:
However, its launch has also raised questions about how Twitch and Amazon have used that content up to now.
Twitch has updated its account settings to let streamers opt out of having their content used to help train the artificial intelligence models of Twitch’s parent company, Amazon.
In a forum dedicated to the topic, more than 16,000 creators expressed opposition to having their content being used by default to train Amazon’s AI systems—a practice that only came to light following the update to the settings.

Amazon.title: Monitor on-premises and multi-cloud AI agents with AgentCore Observability | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleEn: Monitor on-premises and multi-cloud AI agents with AgentCore Observability | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleKo: AgentCore Observability로 온프레미스 및 멀티 클라우드 AI 에이전트 모니터링 | 아마존 웹 서비스
Amazon.summary:
In this post, we show you how to set up observability for agents running outside AWS.
Although Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Observability , a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, provides native tracing, monitoring, and analytics that local cloud monitoring tools don’t offer out of the box, it natively supports only agents deployed on AgentCore runtime in the AWS Cloud.
This allows you to detect hallucinations, monitor for harmful or off-topic responses, track token usage for cost governance, and audit agent behavior across environments.

This allows you to detect hallucinations, monitor for harmful or off-topic responses, track token usage for cost governance, and audit agent behavior across environments.
summaryLinesKo: 이 게시물에서는 AWS 외부에서 실행되는 에이전트에 대한 관찰 가능성을 설정하는 방법을 보여줌
Amazon Bedrock AgentCore의 기능인 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Observability는 로컬 클라우드 모니터링 도구가 기본적으로 제공하지 않는 기본 추적, 모니터링 및 분석을 제공하지만 기본적으로 AWS 클라우드의 AgentCore 런타임에 배포된 에이전트만 지원함
이를 통해 환각을 감지하고, 유해하거나 주제에서 벗어난 응답을 모니터링하고, 비용 거버넌스를 위한 토큰 사용을 추적하고, 환경 전반에 걸쳐 에이전트 동작을 감사할 수 있음

Anthropic.summary:
His code to remove watermarks from Claude-generated text has since gone viral on GitHub, has been bookmarked more than 20,000 times on X, and has drawn more than 100 contributors, with many more incorporating the technology into their own projects.
He incorporated Meyer’s open-source tool into his platform because he similarly disliked the idea of Claude watermarking content even when it’s only been lightly edited and disagreed with the watermark being invisible to the user.
Other coders have developed their own removal tools: Software engineer Erik Hughes took 15 minutes to knock up a tool with Claude that removes invisible and look-alike characters, reorders sentences within paragraphs, and swaps several words for synonyms.

Anthropic.titleEn: How to avoid Claude watermarking your content
Anthropic.summary:
AI labs are companies like any other, with whims and plans of their own -- this is hardly the first or last time one will switch up a product on you.
Rather than expect unrealistic consistency or to be prioritized, the better choice is to invest in the writing you want your name on.
Last week, Anthropic announced it would start watermarking text output from several of its LLMs via Claude to comply with Article 50 of the EU AI Act, which requires participating AI companies to provide transparency tools for AI-generated content.

That's why Anthropic deliberately designs its proposals to slow down leading labs and favor smaller ones, he said.

Anthropic.summary:
This watermarking feature, alongside C2PA support for Claude-processed images, is being introduced to meet Anthropic’s obligations under the European Union’s AI Act , which requires synthetic audio, image, video, and text to include machine-readable marks that enable the content to be detected as artificially generated or manipulated.
Anthropic says the text watermarks won’t make Claude more expensive for users, or “have any practical impact on the quality or content of Claude’s outputs.”
As Anthropic notes, the EU’s AI transparency requirements also impact other major AI developers, so Claude won’t be the only model introducing text watermarks.

Anthropic이 지적했듯이 EU의 AI 투명성 요구 사항은 다른 주요 AI 개발자에게도 영향을 미치므로 Claude가 텍스트 워터마크를 도입하는 유일한 모델은 아님

sourceLines: This watermarking feature, alongside C2PA support for Claude-processed images, is being introduced to meet Anthropic’s obligations under the European Union’s AI Act , which requires synthetic audio, image, video, and text to include machine-readable marks that enable the content to be detected as artificially generated or manipulated.
Anthropic says the text watermarks won’t make Claude more expensive for users, or “have any practical impact on the quality or content of Claude’s outputs.”
As Anthropic notes, the EU’s AI transparency requirements also impact other major AI developers, so Claude won’t be the only model introducing text watermarks.

Anthropic.summary:
It also noted that watermarking is distinct from the AI detection approaches offered by companies like Pangram that look for “tells” in the writing (like the construction “his isn’t [X], it’s [Y]”) to reveal AI usage: “Picking up on these patterns is fundamentally different from checking for a watermark.”
“Watermarking does not impact the quality of Claude’s output,” the company said.
More specifically, Anthropic said it will be using the SynthID-Text approach that the Google DeepMind team outlined in 2024 , and that it plans to release a watermark detection API.

OpenAI.summary:
If the people paged after an alert can’t “conclusively” determine whether an alert is a false positive within 30 minutes, “those teams are expected to pause the activity.”
The company had already put the brakes on a new model, Astra , that it thinks could have “critical” cybersecurity capabilities, and the company says it instituted a two-week pause in reinforcement learning (RL) training on its “latest models intended for deployment” while it tightened up security.

OpenAI.summary:
Last September, after it was sued for allegedly enabling the tragic death of 16-year-old Adam Raine , OpenAI announced it was working on a system that would automatically identify teens and restrict their usage of ChatGPT.
"There's no need for a teen to create a new account or change anything; if we predict you're under 18, or you've told us so, this becomes your default experience," says Lauren Jonas, OpenAI's head of youth and families.
OpenAI is beginning to roll out ChatGPT for Teens globally starting today, and expects to complete the rollout sometime over the next two weeks.

Teen mode will automatically apply to users who identify themselves as being between the ages of 13 and 17, as well as those the system estimates to be under 18.
ChatGPT for Teens is “an experience designed to help teens learn, think critically, deepen understanding, and use AI with confidence,” OpenAI said in a blog post published Tuesday.
Teens or parents can also set “study hours” that automatically enable study mode during designated times.

Teens or parents can also set “study hours” that automatically enable study mode during designated times.

OpenAI는 화요일에 게시된 블로그 게시물에서 청소년을 위한 ChatGPT는 "십대들이 배우고, 비판적으로 생각하고, 이해를 심화하고, 자신있게 AI를 사용할 수 있도록 고안된 경험"이라고 밝힘
청소년이나 부모는 지정된 시간 동안 자동으로 학습 모드를 활성화하는 "학습 시간"을 설정할 수도 있음

OpenAI.title: OpenAI says it's "pacing model development" as AI cybersecurity risks grow too dangerous
OpenAI.titleEn: OpenAI says it's "pacing model development" as AI cybersecurity risks grow too dangerous
OpenAI.titleKo: OpenAI는 AI 사이버 보안 위험이 너무 위험해짐에 따라 "모델 개발 속도를 높이고 있다"고 밝힘
OpenAI.summary:
A new monitoring system alerts within 30 minutes of detecting suspicious behavior, using roughly 20 percent of supervised inference compute depending on workload.
It has, however, disbanded the team behind that framework , shifting responsibilities to other teams.
OpenAI says it's "pacing model development," partly because the upcoming "Astra" model may be close to gaining critical cyberattack capabilities .

OpenAI.titleEn: OpenAI launches a safer ChatGPT for teens — years after teens started using it

OpenAI.summary:
Teens are incredibly adept at working around parental controls and other attempts to lock down digital experiences.
Parents will also be able to use the family tools and parental controls previously introduced to manage settings, receive safety notifications, and set Quiet Hours, among other things.
As OpenAI explains in a blog post , the Study Mode option will give teens guiding questions and step-by-step support to help them understand the material.

OpenAI.title: Genmab launches “AI Everywhere”
OpenAI.summary:
By scaling the adoption of tools like ChatGPT, Genmab invests in every employee’s continuous learning journey.
Genmab recently launched an innovative project to transform the creation of clinical trial documents , including clinical study reports (CSRs), patient safety narratives, and investigational new drug (IND) applications , using GPT‑4o.
AI is poised to become even more integral to the biopharmaceutical industry where advancements are expected to include significantly more powerful and efficient models capable of unprecedented levels of reasoning and understanding, “Our vision goes beyond just streamlining processes; we’re aiming to fundamentally transform how we discover, develop, and deliver treatments to patients,” said Scott Ogden, Head of Genmab’s AI Lab.

SpaceX (xAI, Cursor).titleKo: SpaceX가 AI 코딩 스타트업 Cursor - Engadget을 공식 인수함
SpaceX (xAI, Cursor).summary:
SpaceX, which merged with Elon Musk's AI company xAI earlier this year, paid $60 billion for the purchase.
In its announcement , Cursor said that it will now have access to "the largest fleet of GPUs in the world," which will give it the computing capacity to build and train better models that it can offer its customers at a lower cost.
The companies announced the acquisition in June, but the process apparently started in April, when they teamed up for Cursor's model training efforts.

SpaceX (xAI, Cursor).title: Elon Musk: SpaceX’s AI Revenue Will Surpass Its Entire Space Business “Next Month”
SpaceX (xAI, Cursor).titleEn: Elon Musk: SpaceX’s AI Revenue Will Surpass Its Entire Space Business “Next Month”
SpaceX (xAI, Cursor).titleKo: Elon Musk: SpaceX의 AI 수익이 "다음 달" 전체 우주 사업을 능가할 것
SpaceX (xAI, Cursor).summary:
Musk told SpaceX employees AI revenue will surpass all other space lines by September, with Tesla (TSLA) co-funding a $16.8B Texas compute facility.
Elon Musk reframed how investors should think about the company at a SpaceX all-hands meeting, telling employees that artificial intelligence revenue is on track to exceed every other line of the space business as soon as September 2026.
Musk has said before that SpaceX will launch more AI than the cumulative amount of everything else on Earth, and that within 36 months, space will be the cheapest place to put AI.

summaryLinesKo: Musk는 SpaceX 직원들에게 Tesla(TSLA)가 168억 달러 규모의 텍사스 컴퓨팅 시설에 공동 자금을 지원하면서 AI 수익이 9월까지 다른 모든 우주 라인을 능가할 것이라고 말함

Databricks.summary:
The funding round comes six months after the private data analytics software company raised $5 billion in funding and $2 billion in new debt capacity at a $134 billion valuation.
The company said its Lakehouse data warehousing tool has surpassed a $1.5 billion run rate.
Founded in 2013, Databricks helps companies build AI agents and apps using proprietary data.

Perplexity.titleEn: Perplexity’s free AI offer left it with millions more users in India
Perplexity.titleKo: Perplexity의 무료 AI 제공으로 인도에서는 수백만 명의 사용자가 늘어났음
Perplexity.summary:
In July 2025, Perplexity partnered with Airtel, India’s second biggest telecom operator, to offer a free 12-month Perplexity Pro subscription, normally worth about $200, to the Indian carrier’s 360 million customers.
In the week before the Airtel offer launched, Perplexity averaged about 11,200 downloads a day in India, per Appfigures.
Perplexity’s AI giveaway had an immediate impact, as it saw 5.9 million app downloads in India in July 2025, according to data Sensor Tower shared with TechCrunch.

Mistral AI.titleEn: Mistral AI wants to build 1 gigawatt of European compute by 2030 — and lock in customers now.
Mistral AI.titleKo: Mistral AI는 2030년까지 1기가와트의 유럽 컴퓨팅을 구축하고 지금 고객을 확보하고자 함
Mistral AI.summary:
Nemotron 3.5 Lightning combines strong intelligence with up to 4x output speed of similar-sized models, placing it on the accuracy-speed Pareto frontier for high-volume agent workloads.
NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard enables intelligent model routing, allowing Nemotron 3.5 Lightning to be deployed alongside other models for optimal task allocation, and the open release includes permissive licensing, weights, data, and recipes for extensive customization and broad ecosystem support.
NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is a 30B parameter, open Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 3B active parameters, specifically optimized for high-volume, low-latency execution in always-on AI agents and agentic workflows.
summaryLinesEn: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning combines strong intelligence with up to 4x output speed of similar-sized models, placing it on the accuracy-speed Pareto frontier for high-volume agent workloads.

NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard enables intelligent model routing, allowing Nemotron 3.5 Lightning to be deployed alongside other models for optimal task allocation, and the open release includes permissive licensing, weights, data, and recipes for extensive customization and broad ecosystem support.

NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is a 30B parameter, open Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 3B active parameters, specifically optimized for high-volume, low-latency execution in always-on AI agents and agentic workflows.
summaryLinesKo: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning은 강력한 인텔리전스와 유사한 크기의 모델의 최대 4배 빠른 출력 속도를 결합하여 대용량 에이전트 워크로드를 위한 정확도 속도 Pareto 최전선에 배치함
NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard는 지능형 모델 라우팅을 지원하여 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning을 다른 모델과 함께 배치하여 최적의 작업 할당을 수행할 수 있도록 하며, 공개 릴리스에는 광범위한 사용자 정의 및 폭넓은 생태계 지원을 위한 허용 라이센스, 가중치, 데이터 및 레시피가 포함되어 있음
NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning은 30B 매개변수, 3B 활성 매개변수를 갖춘 개방형 MoE(Mixture-of-Experts) 모델로, 특히 상시 가동되는 AI 에이전트 및 에이전트 워크플로우에서 대용량, 짧은 지연 시간 실행에 최적화되어 있음

NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard는 지능형 모델 라우팅을 지원하여 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning을 다른 모델과 함께 배치하여 최적의 작업 할당을 수행할 수 있도록 하며, 공개 릴리스에는 광범위한 사용자 정의 및 폭넓은 생태계 지원을 위한 허용 라이센스, 가중치, 데이터 및 레시피가 포함되어 있음
NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning은 30B 매개변수, 3B 활성 매개변수를 갖춘 개방형 MoE(Mixture-of-Experts) 모델로, 특히 상시 가동되는 AI 에이전트 및 에이전트 워크플로우에서 대용량, 짧은 지연 시간 실행에 최적화되어 있음

Sierra AI.title: Defense in depth in the age of agents
Sierra AI.titleEn: Defense in depth in the age of agents
Sierra AI.summary:
Supervisors catch nuance that fixed rules can’t, but as agents themselves they share some of the limitations they’re built to detect.
Other threats involve bad content that should never appear in a conversation, regardless of who introduced it.
The basic idea of defense in depth — that you need layers — is the same, but agents change what those layers do.

Sierra AI.title: The follow-up is the sale

Follow up on every lead, answer every customer question, and help people through the buying process.
Most people who get a quote never end up buying the policy because insurance carriers have too many leads to follow up with each one.

Sierra AI.title: Teaching agents to navigate janky IVR systems
Sierra AI.titleEn: Teaching agents to navigate janky IVR systems
Sierra AI.titleKo: 버벅거리는 IVR 시스템을 탐색하는 방법을 상담원에게 교육
Sierra AI.summary:
Agents built on Sierra can now navigate the most challenging IVR systems out of the box: they understand when to call, how to get through a multi-level menu, when to stay silent, and how to recognize when they’ve reached a person.
Or an auto insurance company needs to call a repair shop to get the status and estimated cost of a customer’s repair.
With IVR navigation skills out of the box, an agent’s success rates increase by almost 50% to 85% — and this capability is already being used by a number of our customers.

또는 자동차 보험 회사가 수리점에 전화하여 고객의 수리 상태와 예상 비용을 확인해야 함

Sierra AI.title: Change agents: Chime
Sierra AI.summary:
Resolution rates increased from 50% to over 70%, indicating that more than two-thirds of member questions are now resolved instantly.
At the same time, rising costs of service delivery — the average price of a phone call to a consumer brand ranges from $5 to $20 — is putting real pressure on organizations.
Phone calls are also ineffective due to their high price tag; most conversations are not worth the $20 price tag of a call today.

Replit.title: Replit CEO's surprising take: AI is making software engineering more human
Replit.titleEn: Replit CEO's surprising take: AI is making software engineering more human
Replit.titleKo: Replit CEO의 놀라운 견해 · AI가 소프트웨어 엔지니어링을 더욱 인간적으로 만들고 있음
Replit.summary:
Masad said that Replit, an integrated coding environment he cofounded in 2016, reached an inflection point in 2025 when Anthropic began releasing its Opus models.
Masad said Replit adapted by shifting its mission from teaching people how to code to making coding as easy as possible.
Software engineers themselves have said that coding with AI, while more efficient, quickly leads to burnout, and at least a dozen major companies have laid off workers, citing AI as a reason.

Replit.title: Replit’s CEO on building a company that can run itself
Replit.titleEn: Replit’s CEO on building a company that can run itself
Replit.titleKo: 스스로 운영할 수 있는 회사를 만드는 리플릿 CEO
Replit.summary:
In March, Replit raised $400 million at a $9 billion valuation — triple what it was worth six months earlier.
Last month the company launched Replit Design , an agent-based creative tool.
It was actually kind of a painful moment, because here you are, you dedicated your life — I've been working on making coding easier for literally 15 years, most of my adult life — and I'm saying everything that I worked toward is kind of moot, and the way forward is that we make programming so easy that anyone could do it.

Cohere.summary:

Hugging Face.summary:
What late interaction adds is that it does so without giving up the other direction: when an exact match is what matters (a product code, a surname, a function name), MaxSim still has that token sitting there on its own, where a single-vector model had to average it in with everything else.
PyLate comes up throughout this post, so briefly: Sentence Transformers handled dense and sparse models but not late interaction, so LightOn built PyLate on top of it to close that gap, adding the training, inference, and retrieval pieces these models need.
For ColPali-style visual document retrieval, you also need the image dependencies (see Installation for all extras, and Multimodal Embedding & Reranker Models for multimodal support in general): Sentence Transformers v6.0 requires transformers v5.x, torch 2.2+, and huggingface-hub v1.x.

Hugging Face.title: How Much Memory Does Your Agent Actually Need?
Hugging Face.titleEn: How Much Memory Does Your Agent Actually Need?
Hugging Face.titleKo: 에이전트에 실제로 얼마나 많은 메모리가 필요합니까
Hugging Face.summary:
Curated retrieval can be both the most accurate and the cheapest option: gpt-oss-120b gained +16.1pp task completion at only +5% tokens — and prompt caching keeps even the full guideline set affordable in production.
Because the confusing part of any memory study is what's actually in the context window , we define the configurations up front.
The figure plots TGC to keep it readable; the table adds the stricter SGC metric, where the gains are often larger: Reading the SGC column, the stricter metric usually moves more than TGC — DeepSeek's SGC jumps +16.1pp against a +9.5pp TGC gain — because good guidelines especially help an agent clear every variant of a scenario, not just the average case.

Hugging Face.title: Same Cluster, 33 Points More Utilization: What Changed Was the Order
Hugging Face.titleEn: Same Cluster, 33 Points More Utilization: What Changed Was the Order
Hugging Face.titleKo: 동일한 클러스터, 33포인트 더 많은 활용도 · 순서가 변경된 것
Hugging Face.summary:
The strongest single case was a training-heavy workload on 8 GPUs: utilization went from 53.6% to 87.0%, and value more than doubled, up 105%.
Thirty-three points of a fixed, already-depreciating asset, recovered by reclaiming reserved standby capacity and placing the rest in priority order.
One unit of unmet real-time demand therefore costs what 5 to 10 GPU-timesteps of equal-priority batch work costs.

Hugging Face.title: State of Open Models: Summer 2026 Observations
Hugging Face.titleEn: State of Open Models: Summer 2026 Observations
Hugging Face.summary:
Not one model published in 2026 reaches the download top 25, while thirteen of the twenty-five date from 2022. all-MiniLM-L6-v2 was pulled 1.55 billion times in seven months against 5,156 likes; Kimi-K3 was pulled about 60 times per like it received.
Going forward, however, the industry is likely to shift toward clearer monetization paths from open-source adoption.
Meanwhile, Chinese open models are increasingly optimized for domestic chips, the same competition in reverse, where models are designed around specific hardware ecosystems.

Hugging Face.title: What We Learned by Reproducing 2,200 papers from ICML
Hugging Face.titleEn: What We Learned by Reproducing 2,200 papers from ICML
Hugging Face.titleKo: ICML의 2,200개 논문을 재현하여 우리가 배운 것
Hugging Face.summary:
In total, 3,978 individual claims were confirmed with real experiments. 23% of examined papers (496) had at least one claim falsified or contested.
Participants received $20 in Hugging Face compute credits to run experiments on HF Jobs ; across the challenge, participants launched 2,962 cloud jobs.
ICML 2026 received 23,918 submissions and accepted 6,352 papers , roughly double the previous year, continuing an exponential trend that is at least partly driven by AI agents making it faster to run experiments and write them up.

Hugging Face.title: Record, train, and deploy from one place with Strands Agents, LeRobot, and Hugging Face Storage Buckets
Hugging Face.titleEn: Record, train, and deploy from one place with Strands Agents, LeRobot, and Hugging Face Storage Buckets
Hugging Face.titleKo: Strands Agents, LeRobot 및 Hugging Face Storage Buckets를 사용하여 한 곳에서 기록, 훈련 및 배포
Hugging Face.summary:
To record on a physical SO-101, LeRobot's record CLI handles the leader-follower bring-up: The dataset lands on disk in the same format as the simulation recording, so the same sync call takes it to a bucket: sync_dataset_to_bucket("./recordings", "my-org/robot-fave", run_id="run-021") (or the hf sync ./recordings hf://buckets/my-org/robot-fave/run-021 CLI it wraps).
The first post in this series introduced Strands Robots , an open source SDK from AWS ( Apache 2.0 ) that exposes robot abstractions, simulation, and the LeRobot stack as AgentTools you compose into a single Strands agent.
Each of those decisions comes up dozens of times over a collection campaign, and each one needs a look at what came back before the next command goes out.

Hugging Face.title: Thinking of ACE? We Can Do It with Fewer Tokens
Hugging Face.titleEn: Thinking of ACE? We Can Do It with Fewer Tokens
Hugging Face.titleKo: 에이스를 생각하시나요 · 더 적은 토큰으로 할 수 있음
Hugging Face.summary:
On DeepSeek-V3.2 the story flips: the stronger model absorbs ACE's full playbook well enough to edge us on Medium, but we lead Easy, Hard, and Overall — with more capacity to spare, more lessons (delivered our way) keep helping instead of crowding each other out.
Two recent systems do exactly this, on the same kind of agent: ACE (Agentic Context Engineering) and our ALTK-Evolve ( introduced here ).
Every distinct guideline keeps a support count — how many independent episodes produced it — and we never summarize the store down to a handful of rules.

Two recent systems do exactly this, on the same kind of agent: ACE (Agentic Context Engineering) and our ALTK-Evolve ( introduced here ).
Every distinct guideline keeps a support count — how many independent episodes produced it — and we never summarize the store down to a handful of rules.
summaryLinesKo: DeepSeek-V3.2에서는 이야기가 반전됨 · 더 강한 모델은 ACE의 전체 플레이북을 잘 흡수하여 Medium에서 우위를 점할 수 있지만 우리는 Easy, Hard 및 General을 선도함 · 더 많은 여유 공간과 더 많은 교훈(우리 방식으로 제공됨)이 서로 밀리지 않고 계속 도움을 줌
동일한 종류의 에이전트에서 ACE(Agentic Context Engineering)와 ALTK-Evolve(여기에 소개됨)라는 두 가지 최근 시스템이 정확히 이 작업을 수행함

Writer.title: WRITER Named a Market Shaper in the July 2026 Gartner® Emerging Market Quadrant™ for AI Agents for Marketing — Startup Vendors
Writer.titleEn: WRITER Named a Market Shaper in the July 2026 Gartner® Emerging Market Quadrant™ for AI Agents for Marketing — Startup Vendors
Writer.titleKo: 작가는 2026년 7월 Gartner® Emerging Market Quadrant™에서 마케팅용 AI 에이전트 부문의 Market Shaper로 선정됨 · — 스타트업 공급업체
Writer.summary:
According to Gartner, “Market Shapers are ushering in a new era of industrialized, autonomous revenue engines, combining enterprise-grade governance, compliance and data security with frontier AI innovation, empowering marketing teams to move beyond pilots to scalable, autonomous agent orchestration as the new standard for modern GTM execution.”
WRITER believes it is at the forefront of this shift, combining powerful agent capabilities with an enterprise-grade platform that turns an organization’s expertise into shared infrastructure the whole team can use, connects go-to-market work, and keeps outputs on-brand, compliant, and supervised as agentic AI scales.
In WRITER’s view, the report captures a critical moment as marketing and revenue teams move beyond automating isolated tasks to reshape the customer journey itself – a shift that requires more than capable models or copilots that make individuals faster.

WRITER believes it is at the forefront of this shift, combining powerful agent capabilities with an enterprise-grade platform that turns an organization’s expertise into shared infrastructure the whole team can use, connects go-to-market work, and keeps outputs on-brand, compliant, and supervised as agentic AI scales.

In WRITER’s view, the report captures a critical moment as marketing and revenue teams move beyond automating isolated tasks to reshape the customer journey itself – a shift that requires more than capable models or copilots that make individuals faster.

WRITER는 강력한 에이전트 기능을 엔터프라이즈급 플랫폼과 결합하여 조직의 전문 지식을 팀 전체가 사용할 수 있는 공유 인프라로 전환하고, 출시 작업을 연결하고, 에이전트 AI 규모에 따라 브랜드에 맞는 출력을 유지하고 규정을 준수하며 감독하는 엔터프라이즈급 플랫폼을 결합하여 이러한 변화의 최전선에 있다고 믿음
WRITER의 관점에서 보고서는 마케팅 및 수익 팀이 격리된 작업을 자동화하는 것에서 벗어나 고객 여정 자체를 재구성하는 중요한 순간을 포착함 · 이러한 변화에는 개인을 더 빠르게 만드는 유능한 모델이나 부조종사 이상의 것이 필요함

Writer.title: How to show up where AI is listening: Building AI visibility from buyer conversations
Writer.titleEn: How to show up where AI is listening: Building AI visibility from buyer conversations
Writer.titleKo: AI가 듣고 있는 곳에 표시하는 방법 · 구매자 대화를 통해 AI 가시성 구축
Writer.summary:
You’re building content from the exact language they use, at the speed your buyers expect, in the voice your market recognizes.
It means deciding which questions matter most, building PR and communications around those questions, showing up in the social and review platforms AI reads, and making sure your story is consistent across every surface where AI forms an opinion about your brand.
Marketbridge analyzed more than 17,000 AI citations across multiple industries and reached the same conclusion: “Organizations that treat GEO as a technical add-on risk missing the bigger picture.”

이는 어떤 질문이 가장 중요한지 결정하고, 해당 질문을 중심으로 PR 및 커뮤니케이션을 구축하고, AI가 읽는 소셜 및 리뷰 플랫폼에 표시하고, AI가 브랜드에 대한 의견을 형성하는 모든 표면에서 스토리가 일관되도록 하는 것을 의미함

Writer.title: WRITER Makes Agentic AI Economically Sustainable at Enterprise Scale With Palmyra X6 Release and Major Harness Upgrades
Writer.titleEn: WRITER Makes Agentic AI Economically Sustainable at Enterprise Scale With Palmyra X6 Release and Major Harness Upgrades
Writer.titleKo: WRITER, Palmyra X6 출시 및 주요 하네스 업그레이드를 통해 Agentic AI를 엔터프라이즈 규모에서 경제적으로 지속 가능하게 만듬
Writer.summary:
Together, the upgrades allow marketing and revenue teams to confidently scale their most ambitious agentic workflows in production without token costs holding them back.
New governance tools to control spend and scale what works WRITER also launched a major upgrade to reporting and governance controls that gives leaders a clear view into the agentic workflows being used across their teams.
X6 delivered the best combination of capability and cost among the models WRITER tested, scoring an average of 0.87 (out of 1.00) across all nine evaluations at $2 per million input tokens and $8 per million output tokens, ahead of Claude Opus 4.8 (0.86 at $15/$75 per million), Claude Sonnet 4.6 (0.85 at $3/$15), GPT-5.5 (0.80 at $5/$15) and Gemini 3.1 (0.77 at $2.50/$10).
summaryLinesEn: Together, the upgrades allow marketing and revenue teams to confidently scale their most ambitious agentic workflows in production without token costs holding them back.

New governance tools to control spend and scale what works WRITER also launched a major upgrade to reporting and governance controls that gives leaders a clear view into the agentic workflows being used across their teams.

X6 delivered the best combination of capability and cost among the models WRITER tested, scoring an average of 0.87 (out of 1.00) across all nine evaluations at $2 per million input tokens and $8 per million output tokens, ahead of Claude Opus 4.8 (0.86 at $15/$75 per million), Claude Sonnet 4.6 (0.85 at $3/$15), GPT-5.5 (0.80 at $5/$15) and Gemini 3.1 (0.77 at $2.50/$10).
summaryLinesKo: 업그레이드를 통해 마케팅 및 수익 팀은 토큰 비용을 부담하지 않고도 프로덕션에서 가장 야심 찬 에이전트 워크플로우를 자신있게 확장할 수 있음
지출을 제어하고 효과를 확장하는 새로운 거버넌스 도구 WRITER는 또한 리더들이 팀 전체에서 사용되는 에이전트 워크플로에 대한 명확한 보기를 제공하는 보고 및 거버넌스 제어에 대한 주요 업그레이드를 출시함

X6는 WRITER가 테스트한 모델 중 최고의 성능과 비용 조합을 제공하여 입력 토큰 백만 달러당 2달러 및 출력 토큰 백만 달러당 8달러로 9개 평가에서 평균 0.87점(1.00점 만점)을 얻었음 · 이는 Claude Opus 4.8(백만 달러당 15/75달러에서 0.86), Claude Sonnet 4.6(3달러/15달러에서 0.85), GPT-5.5를 앞섰음 · ($5/$15에서 0.80) 및 Gemini 3.1($2.50/$10에서 0.77)

Writer.title: WRITER raises $100 million in Series B to deliver on generative AI for enterprises
Writer.titleEn: WRITER raises $100 million in Series B to deliver on generative AI for enterprises
Writer.titleKo: WRITER, 기업용 생성 AI 제공을 위해 시리즈 B에서 1억 달러 모금
Writer.summary:
I’m excited to announce that WRITER has raised $100 million in Series B funding!
Here are just a few examples of how customers create, analyze, and govern with WRITER to achieve significant business impact: 6sense increased their writing output by 50% and achieves 100% brand compliance on written content.
“We believe that generative AI usage within enterprises is hitting an inflection point, and WRITER stands out to us as a leader in providing a full stack and secure platform to deliver on AI’s incredible promise.”

Here are just a few examples of how customers create, analyze, and govern with WRITER to achieve significant business impact: 6sense increased their writing output by 50% and achieves 100% brand compliance on written content.

“We believe that generative AI usage within enterprises is hitting an inflection point, and WRITER stands out to us as a leader in providing a full stack and secure platform to deliver on AI’s incredible promise.”
summaryLinesKo: WRITER가 시리즈 B 자금으로 1억 달러를 모금했다는 소식을 발표하게 되어 기쁨
다음은 고객이 WRITER를 사용하여 상당한 비즈니스 효과를 달성하기 위해 생성, 분석 및 관리하는 방법에 대한 몇 가지 예임 · 6sense는 글쓰기 출력을 50% 증가시키고 서면 콘텐츠에 대해 100% 브랜드 준수를 달성함
"우리는 기업 내에서 생성적 AI 사용이 변곡점에 도달했다고 믿고 있으며, WRITER는 AI의 놀라운 약속을 이행하기 위한 풀 스택 및 보안 플랫폼을 제공하는 리더로서 우리에게 두각을 나타내고 있음"

Writer.title: New at WRITER: Agentic work that scales without blowing the budget
Writer.titleEn: New at WRITER: Agentic work that scales without blowing the budget
Writer.titleKo: WRITER의 새로운 기능 · 예산을 초과하지 않고 확장되는 에이전트 작업
Writer.summary:
At the same time, enterprises are losing control of AI spend, burning through annual AI budgets in a matter of months and spending up to $500 million a month on uncapped AI.
The shift is from piloting agents to running them in production, across thousands of employees, with spend governed and aligned to ROI instead of left uncapped.
It’s engineered for the work most teams run every day: the high-volume personalization, research, and content work where marketing and sales teams need to scale without the bill running away.

DeepSeek.summary:
One recharge to use GPT, Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek inside Open Design: 20+ flagship models, zero config, billed by real token usage.
If you also believe design should be open — become an Open Design Fellow, shape the product alongside the core team, and help more people take part in defining the future of design.
Start from Home , orchestrate repeat workflows with Automation , distill a brand contract in Design System , and extend with Plugins and integrations ; inside any project's Studio , the same design system streams out prototypes, live artifacts, HyperFrames, decks, and images.

의심하지 않는 사람들을 착취하거나 괴롭히는 Meta-glasses 영상을 삭제하기로 한 Instagram의 결정은 위험이 이미 현실이라는 것을 암묵적으로 인정하는 것임

Meta AI.title: Meta Confirms New WhatsApp On-Device AI-Powered Scam Alert Beta
Meta AI.titleEn: Meta Confirms New WhatsApp On-Device AI-Powered Scam Alert Beta
Meta AI.titleKo: Meta, 새로운 WhatsApp 온디바이스 AI 기반 사기 경고 베타 확인
Meta AI.summary:
Hot on the heels of a confirmed WhatsApp scam attack campaign that doesn’t require your password to access your account, Meta has announced it is starting to roll out new protections for WhatsApp users by way of an optional Scam Alert feature powered by an on-device machine learning model.
Now Meta is taking a similar route with its Scam Alert functionality for WhatsApp users.
“No message content leaves the device for classification or is auto-reported to WhatsApp, Meta, or anyone else,” the engineering team stated.
summaryLinesEn: Hot on the heels of a confirmed WhatsApp scam attack campaign that doesn’t require your password to access your account, Meta has announced it is starting to roll out new protections for WhatsApp users by way of an optional Scam Alert feature powered by an on-device machine learning model.
Now Meta is taking a similar route with its Scam Alert functionality for WhatsApp users.
“No message content leaves the device for classification or is auto-reported to WhatsApp, Meta, or anyone else,” the engineering team stated.
summaryLinesKo: 계정에 액세스하기 위해 비밀번호가 필요하지 않은 확인된 WhatsApp 사기 공격 캠페인에 이어 Meta는 온디바이스 머신 러닝 모델로 구동되는 선택적 사기 경고 기능을 통해 WhatsApp 사용자를 위한 새로운 보호 기능을 출시하기 시작했다고 발표함
이제 Meta는 WhatsApp 사용자를 위한 사기 경고 기능을 통해 비슷한 경로를 취하고 있음
엔지니어링 팀은 “어떤 메시지 콘텐츠도 분류를 위해 장치를 떠나거나 WhatsApp, Meta 또는 다른 누구에게 자동 보고되지 않음” · 라고 말함

Meta AI.title: GitHub - facebook/astryx: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
Meta AI.titleEn: GitHub - facebook/astryx: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
Meta AI.titleKo: GitHub - facebook/astryx: 완전히 사용자 정의 가능하고 에이전트가 준비된 오픈 소스 디자인 시스템
Meta AI.summary:
Astryx is an open source design system that grew inside Meta over the last eight years, where it became the most-used and largest design system in the company — powering 13,000+ apps and shaped by the engineers, designers, and product teams who depend on it every day.
The building blocks you'd reach for are exported directly, and when you need to go deeper, swizzle ejects a component's full source into your project to own.
Notifications You must be signed in to change notification settings An open source design system that's fully customizable and built for how we build now: by people and the agents working alongside them.

The building blocks you'd reach for are exported directly, and when you need to go deeper, swizzle ejects a component's full source into your project to own.

Notifications You must be signed in to change notification settings An open source design system that's fully customizable and built for how we build now: by people and the agents working alongside them.
summaryLinesKo: Astryx는 지난 8년 동안 Meta 내부에서 성장한 오픈 소스 디자인 시스템으로, 회사에서 가장 많이 사용되는 최대 규모의 디자인 시스템이 됨 · 이는 13,000개 이상의 앱을 지원하고 매일 이에 의존하는 엔지니어, 디자이너 및 제품 팀에 의해 형성됨
접근하려는 빌딩 블록은 직접 내보내지며, 더 깊이 들어가야 할 경우 swizzle은 소유할 프로젝트에 구성 요소의 전체 소스를 내보냄
알림 알림 설정을 변경하려면 로그인해야 함 · 완벽하게 사용자 정의할 수 있고 현재 구축하는 방식에 맞게 구축된 오픈 소스 디자인 시스템 · 사람과 함께 일하는 에이전트

Kling AI.title: Kuaishou’s Kling AI revenue tops RMB850 million in Q2, up more than 200% · TechNode
Kling AI.titleEn: Kuaishou’s Kling AI revenue tops RMB850 million in Q2, up more than 200% · TechNode
Kling AI.titleKo: Kuaishou의 Kling AI 매출, 2분기에 200% 이상 증가한 8억 5천만 위안 돌파 · TechNode
Kling AI.summary:
Kuaishou’s Kling AI video-generation business generated more than RMB850 million in revenue during the second quarter, up more than 200% year on year and 30% from the previous quarter.
Kling AI’s revenue reached RMB1.5 billion in the first half of the year.
summaryLinesEn: Kuaishou’s Kling AI video-generation business generated more than RMB850 million in revenue during the second quarter, up more than 200% year on year and 30% from the previous quarter.
Kling AI’s revenue reached RMB1.5 billion in the first half of the year.
summaryLinesKo: Kuaishou의 Kling AI 비디오 생성 사업은 2분기에 8억 5천만 위안 이상의 수익을 창출했는데, 이는 전년 동기 대비 200% 이상, 전 분기 대비 30% 증가한 수치임
Kling AI의 상반기 매출은 15억 위안에 달함
